subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella stay open until all Anthropic signed-thinking replay variants are resolved, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 the canonical remaining prevention issue now that the recovery-carrier fixes landed?
rationale: The merged recovery fixes are on main, but the remaining prevention path changes Anthropic thinking replay semantics and has overlapping open candidate PRs with compatibility risk.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded after posting a clear handoff to the focused remaining issue and candidate PRs.

options.title: Treat Recovery as Enough
options.body: Close after deciding that merged recovery carriers are the intended product boundary and prevention policy should be deferred elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: They already framed the recovery half as landed while keeping this issue open for unresolved create/prevention evidence.
